title: Repository Search
shortDescription: Search your local git repositories and GitHub in one list, with git status and clone, fork and sync actions.
description: Repository Search queries your local clone folders and GitHub at the same time and ranks your own repositories first. Paired repositories (a GitHub repo with a local clone) open in Explorer, VS Code or the browser and can be synced; uncloned GitHub repositories can be cloned; local repositories without a remote can be published with Init; other people's public repositories can be starred, forked or cloned. Local rows show a posh-git style status summary. Top matches can also appear in Command Palette's global search. A GitHub token is optional and is stored in Windows Credential Manager, never in settings.
